svg.text: THE HOLDING YARD: 30 shade-cloth hoop tunnels
WINDBREAK: eucalyptus 25-30 m + 3 m concrete lateral (y -900)
winter rye, 1 m swale, fog pool
Frost night in the bloom: wilderness concept "rows"
Plan metres, estate origin (x east, y north). North up.
mature almond bloom, rows N-S, 6.7 x 5.5 m, canopy 1.6-5.5 m
container trees: boxed cypress, olives, topiary
glasshouse: 7 m gutters, lit all night
frost fan, 10.6 m tower (noise mask ~120 m; sniper perch)
A Down the Row: ~1.6 km, fast, exposed lanes
B Holding Yard + Pivot + Glass: ~2.3 km, hidden
C Drive edge + UTV / trolley: ~1.6 km, gamble
pursuers: foot squads from gate, trucks up the drive,
headland + road patrols; Grimble (easter egg) from the west
- falls ~1.5 m north to south over the section
- canal embankment +3 m, rail embankment +1.5 m
- lateral ditch -2 m under the windbreak
- glasshouse pad +0.5 m; root windrows 3 m
SIGHT: along a row = the block (400-800 m);
under the canopy skirt. Night fog 120-180 m,
6:20 dawn: fans stop, fog lifts, train 90 s.
